page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening, page 16) with running head "AK" at top; one text column of dictionary entries; at the right edge a narrow strip of the facing page with cropped marginal glosses, which are not transcribed as text beyond what is legible.

main_text.p: ᾿Ακριβῶς ὦ exquiro. F. ἀκριβώσω. P. ἠκρίβωκα. A. 1. ἠκρίβωσα, Matth.2.7.
᾿Ακρὶς ἰδος ἡ locusta, ἁλὰ τὸ ποσιτεὶν τὰ ἄκρα τῶν φυτῶν, quòd depascatur extremitates plantarum, Matth.3.4.
᾿Ακροατὴς ὁ auditor. à verbo ἀκροᾶσθαι ἀκούω audio. F. ἀκούσομαι. P. pass. ἠκροάμην, Rom.2.13.
᾿Ακροβυστία ἡ præputium. ex ἄκρον extremus, & βύω tego, ὅτι τὸ ἄκρον βύει, quod extremam pudendi partem tegat, Rom.2.25.
᾿Ακρογωνιαῖος ὁ angularis, imus. ex ἄκρον extremus, & γωνία ἡ angulus. q.d. ἐν ἄκρᾳ γωνίᾳ τιθεὶς, Eph.2.20.

᾿Ακροθίνια τῶν τὰ primitiæ, item spoliorum decimæ, quasi τὰ ἄκρα θινὸς summitates acervi, quod primitiæ ex summitate acervi excerpentur. à singul. ἀκροθίνιον τὸ, ex ἄκρον extremitas, & θίνος vel θῖς θινὸς ὁ ἡ acervus, meta. ein hauffen/ Heb.7.4.
᾿Ακυρόω ὦ antiquo, irritum reddo, authoritate spolio. F. ώσω. P. ἠκύρωκα. A. 1. ἠκύρωσα, ab ἀκυρ-ος ὁ ἡ authoritate privatus. ex α priv. & κῦρ-ος τὸ authoritas, Matth.15.6.
᾿Ακωλύτως adv. nullo vetante, sine obstaculo. ab adj. ἀκώλυτος ὁ ἡ qui non impeditur. ex α priv. & κωλυτὸς qui prohiberi potest, à Th. κωλύω impedio, veto, cohibeo. Act.28.31.

page.notes: Right-hand strip is the cropped facing page with fragmentary marginal glosses (partly Latin and German, e.g. "ein hauffen", "Rom.", "Matth."); largely illegible and not transcribed. Greek accents and breathings in the entries are approximate given the scan's small type; reference marks are not visible. Entry "Ἀκρογωνιαῖος" line and some Greek forms are uncertain.
